purpose: Determine whether retained-cache activity executes in the expensive construction windows before selecting a cache runtime change. Arithmetic equality and identical allocation counts alone do not identify elapsed costs.
proposed_diagnostic: Create a separate source copy and target. Add scoped counters only for retained-normalizer entry/fallback, cache lookup/hit, closed-payload copy/publication and evaluation-cache cell allocation. No algorithm, arithmetic order, budget, cache ownership or output changes.
driver: Reuse the original fixture/expected/witness suffix and all eight construction/first/warm/cloned families at 4096 inputs. Match every existing public trace row and witness against construction-trace-v1 full-cache runs; discard no failures or adverse rows.
scope_limits: Review every counter insertion and reset/snapshot boundary before building.
Count diagnostic events without using instrumented durations as runtime comparisons. Avoid tracing allocations or formatting inside counted bodies.
Preserve the full cache-free failure, full-cache consumer regressions and all closed samples. No rerun to replace them.
If a construction window has no cache activity, do not claim cache-copy removal can cure that window. Code generation and environment remain unproven alternatives.
No runtime candidate is prepared, and complete native reports, full qualification and required application/library costs still govern admission.
